findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_qualified_reqs, get_changes, find_company, register_webhook · Private data: who_is_hiring_for, search_jobs, get_role, find_qualified_reqs, find_company, register_webhook, write_outcome · Public sink: search_jobs, get_role, get_changes, find_company, register_webhook, watch_company.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_qualified_reqs, get_changes, find_company, register_webhook · Private data: who_is_hiring_for, search_jobs, get_role, find_qualified_reqs, find_company, register_webhook, write_outcome · Public sink: search_jobs, get_role, get_changes, find_company, register_webhook, watch_company

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
